notes: Partition verified: 35 source and 53 target tokens each covered once.

The second 'with' of 'and with wizards' is the distributed repetition of the preposition the English verb needs to reach its bare object, so it stays in the verb's discontinuous unit under rules 25 and 44 rather than being marked added.

'them that had familiar spirits' is one unit on ov, headed on 'spirits' because the ASV writes that class noun alone elsewhere for words of the class and 'familiar' is its specifier; 'familiar' is the defensible competing head under rule 31.
The article on ra is unrepresented because hirbah is what the written 'much' answers to (rule 41's limit), and the lamed before the infinitive is unrepresented under rules 40 and 52.
